source_brief: Ioan Week 2: hold the loop fixed and change only how the next point is chosen.
gp_model_note: GaussianProcessRegressor on {-1,+1} labels is a Week 2 stand-in, not the final GP classifier.
fairness_note: For each seed, all acquisition rules use the same Branin threshold, pool, test set, GP regressor, budget, and initial labelled indices. Only the acquisition rule changes.

fixed_error_tolerance_check.metric: fraction of exact Branin test labels misclassified
fixed_error_tolerance_check.note: This is a test-error tolerance proxy for Ioan's fixed-tolerance DONE WHEN note, not a separate geometric contour-distance metric.

random.description: Uniformly random unlabelled pool point; floor baseline.

smallest_abs_mu.description: Choose the point closest to the current boundary: argmin |mu|.

straddle.description: Choose largest 1.96*sigma - |mu|: near boundary and uncertain.

randomized_straddle.description: Draw one beta ~ chi-square(df=2) per step and choose largest sqrt(beta)*sigma - |mu|.

expected_feasibility.description: Contour-focused expected-improvement-style score E[max((1.96*sigma)^2 - Y^2, 0)] for Y ~ Normal(mu, sigma^2).
